title: A maintenance check-in folded into the kickoff, and "mostly" taken lightly
origin: Spec #9 (step log and next step), example "Good, maintenance in a kickoff" and rule 4

history.text: [photo of a watch showing a 15 minute workout] done

plan.reason: Fifteen minutes at home, right after work.

testerLines: on it! and mostly, missed one night this week lol
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a maintenance check-in.
shouldHaveHappened: The 9 am kickoff names today's 20 push-ups and 30 squats and folds in one light line asking if she's still in bed by 10:30, as its only question; no push or proof ask about bedtime. Her "mostly, missed one night" is taken lightly as still keeping it up (no guilt, no plan talk about bedtime, no lecture), and the reply stays short and points to today's workout.
